The '''Reyes' Rebels Outfit''' is an [[Outfits|outfit]] in ''[[Red Dead Redemption]]'' worn by [[Marston]].

==Description==
The Reyes' Rebels outfit consists of an intact poncho, a dark red headband, and very worn shoes. It appears to be worn over Marston's [[Cowboy Outfit|Cowboy outfit]], even while playing as [[Jack Marston]] in the game's epilogue. It is one of the three outfits unlockable in [[Nuevo Paraíso]], alongside the [[Mexican Poncho]] and the [[Bandito Outfit|Bandito outfit]].

This outfit disguises the player as one of [[Abraham Reyes]]' [[Reyes' Rebels|Rebels]], who become [[Nuevo Paraíso]]'s law enforcement organization following the [[Missions in Redemption#Abraham Reyes|mission]] [[An Appointed Time|"An Appointed Time"]], after which this outfit can be obtained. As such, the player will not be pursued by law enforcers, posses, and bounty hunters while in Mexico if they wear this outfit.

This outfit effectively works as a Mexican counterpart to the [[US Marshal Uniform|U.S. Marshal]] outfit.

==Acquisition==
Reyes' Rebels outfit can be acquired by completing the following requirements:

*Search [[Sepulcro]] - Just west of the eastern-most corner of the cemetery in a chest (along the southern wall inside the cemetery). 
*Complete the [[Strangers|Stranger]] [[Missions in Redemption#Stranger Side-missions|side-mission]] "[[Poppycock]]". 
*Complete a [[Horsebreaking]] job in [[Chuparosa]]. 
*Complete the [[Strangers|Stranger]] [[Missions in Redemption#Stranger Side-missions|side-mission]] "[[Love is the Opiate]]". 
*Win at [[Five Finger Fillet]] in [[Torquemada]] - defeat all opponents. 
*Purchase the scrap at the [[General Store]] in [[Escalera]]. <sup>†</sup>
::<small>† = <font color="#A4DDED">Note: Scrap is not available to be purchased until the player has completed the </font>[[Abraham Reyes]] [[Missions in Redemption#Abraham Reyes|mission]] "[[An Appointed Time]]".</small>
<br />
Alternatively, the player can enable the [[Cheats in Redemption|cheat code]] "Gang chic", which unlocks this outfit alongside the [[Walton's Gang Outfit|Walton's Gang]], [[Bollard Twins Outfit|Bollard Twins]], [[Bandito Outfit|Bandito]] and [[Treasure Hunter Outfit|Treasure Hunter]] outfits. However, enabling this cheat code will disable achievements and autosaving.

==Trivia==
[[File:JohnMarston-UndeadNightmare-Undead-ReyesRebelsOutfitArtwork.jpg|thumb|300px|An artwork depicting an [[undead]] Marston wearing the Reyes' Rebels outfit.]]
*If the player uses a cheat to get this outfit before they enter Chuparosa for the first time, it will show John in his hat but he'll be wearing what appears to be the Mexican poncho in perfect condition, but a color glitch will appear, making John's hat band red instead of black.
*While the Reyes' Rebels outfit is not available to be worn in ''[[Undead Nightmare]]'', one of the DLC's trailers ended with an artwork of what appears to be an undead Marston in the outfit.
